general_cufft.mcg_cutoff_note: Permits <= 0.1% discrete step-cutoff flips only in intermediate ionized_box.nion_conditional_filtered_mcg when USE_MCGS=True + general FFT (1-ULP boundary at pow(10, log10_mturn_acg) > atomic_cooling_threshold * 1.001 in upstream src/interp_tables.c:1152).

upstream_notes.upstream_behavior: Upstream 21cmFAST 4.3.2 C code (src/IonisationBox.c:838-866 + src/interp_tables.c:63) does not populate Nion_conditional_table1D_acg_prev separately and overwrites the single 1D ACG table, triggering out-of-bounds read/crash on CPU.
upstream_notes.gpu_behavior: GPU port indexes (previous, mini) 1D source tables separately and executes cleanly (verified in Suite B case mcg_only_e_gpu_safe).
Matches upstream CPU behavior identically (verified error parity in Suite C case auto_pc_z_const_ion_eff).
